author: Contributor 68
about: RFC 5321 Appendix D.1-D.4 client turns, against a relay configured through its operator door. Postfix reply text differs as RFC 5321 section 4.2 permits. D.3 replays the second hop explicitly; the twin captures mail and does not deliver to another server.

steps.name: Operator configures d1 preconditions from RFC Appendix D
D.1: bar.com opens a connection to foo.com, where Jones and Brown have mailboxes and Green has none
steps.example: D.1 A Typical SMTP Transaction Scenario#0 (connect)

exampleDiffers.text: RFC 5321 section 4.2 allows receiver-dependent reply text. This Postfix submission relay advertises ESMTP in its greeting; its hostname is the operator setting from this scenario.

steps.name: bar.com greets foo.com
steps.example: D.1 A Typical SMTP Transaction Scenario#1 EHLO bar.com

exampleDiffers.lines: RFC 5321 section 3.2 requires EHLO to list the extensions this server supports. The operator-selected hostname is the first line; this submission relay offers PIPELINING, SIZE, ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES, 8BITMIME and SMTPUTF8, without DSN or HELP.

undecided.lines: Remaining capability keywords are the configured submission relay extensions, not the RFC scenario server's defaults.

steps.name: Smith@bar.com is the sender
steps.example: D.1 A Typical SMTP Transaction Scenario#2 MAIL FROM:<Smith@bar.com>

exampleDiffers.text: The scenario's text is "OK"; the twin sends Postfix's "250 2.1.0 Ok" (postfix/src/smtpd/smtpd.c mail_cmd). RFC 5321 4.2: "the text may be receiver dependent and context dependent, so there are likely to be varying texts for each reply code".

steps.name: Jones@foo.com, who has a mailbox, is accepted
steps.example: D.1 A Typical SMTP Transaction Scenario#3 RCPT TO:<Jones@foo.com>

exampleDiffers.text: The scenario's text is "OK"; the twin sends Postfix's "250 2.1.5 Ok" (postfix/src/smtpd/smtpd.c rcpt_cmd). RFC 5321 4.2: "the text may be receiver dependent and context dependent, so there are likely to be varying texts for each reply code".

steps.name: Green@foo.com has no mailbox at foo.com and is refused
steps.example: D.1 A Typical SMTP Transaction Scenario#4 RCPT TO:<Green@foo.com>

exampleDiffers.text: RFC D.1 gives 550 No such user here; the relay adds the enhanced status class 5.1.1. The recipient is absent from the operator-configured local recipient table.

steps.name: Brown@foo.com, who has a mailbox, is accepted
steps.example: D.1 A Typical SMTP Transaction Scenario#5 RCPT TO:<Brown@foo.com>

exampleDiffers.text: The scenario's text is "OK"; the twin sends Postfix's "250 2.1.5 Ok" (postfix/src/smtpd/smtpd.c rcpt_cmd). RFC 5321 4.2: "the text may be receiver dependent and context dependent, so there are likely to be varying texts for each reply code".

steps.name: bar.com starts the message
steps.example: D.1 A Typical SMTP Transaction Scenario#6 DATA

exampleDiffers.text: The scenario's text is "Start mail input; end with <CRLF>.<CRLF>"; the twin sends Postfix's "354 End data with <CR><LF>.<CR><LF>" (postfix/src/smtpd/smtpd.c data_cmd). RFC 5321 4.2: "the text may be receiver dependent and context dependent, so there are likely to be varying texts for each reply code".

steps.name: The message is sent and queued
steps.example: D.1 A Typical SMTP Transaction Scenario#7 Blah blah blah...

exampleDiffers.text: The scenario's text is "OK"; the twin sends Postfix's "250 2.0.0 Ok: queued as %s" (postfix/src/smtpd/smtpd.c receive_data_message). RFC 5321 4.2: "the text may be receiver dependent and context dependent, so there are likely to be varying texts for each reply code".

undecided.text: The queue identifier is generated by the relay, not an example input.

steps.name: bar.com closes the channel
steps.example: D.1 A Typical SMTP Transaction Scenario#8 QUIT

exampleDiffers.text: The scenario's text is "foo.com Service closing transmission channel"; the twin sends Postfix's "221 2.0.0 Bye" (postfix/src/smtpd/smtpd.c quit_cmd: smtpd_chat_reply(state, "221 2.0.0 Bye")), which names no domain although RFC 5321 4.2.2 lists 221 as "221 <domain> Service closing transmission channel".

steps.name: The message D.1 queued is from Smith@bar.com, for Jones and Brown and not Green
